title: The Boyfriend
author: Freida McFadden
summary: A psychological thriller about a woman whose new relationship may be hiding something, told in the quick, twisty style the author is known for.
readIf: you like short-chaptered psychological thrillers that you can finish in a weekend.
skipIf: you want a thriller with deep characterisation or realistic police procedure.

pairings.reason: Another thriller where an apparently perfect romantic situation turns out to be dangerously controlled.
The benchmark for relationship thrillers where nobody is quite who they say they are.
A bleaker, more extreme look at a hidden controlling relationship.
